promotionCandidate.description: Judgment Promotion Loop Phase 1 candidate contract (#1568-A / #1621). Stored under context.promotionCandidate when type is promotion_candidate. Generation-only: adoption/approval into shared assets happens in a separate human-reviewed PR (#1568-B).

recurrenceCount.description: How many recurring feedback entries backed this candidate.

detector.description: Which primitive detected the recurrence (e.g. feedback-rule-candidates).

clusterKey.description: Group key the candidate was clustered on. Phase 1: (skillId, feedbackType) joined by '::'.

evidence.description: Traceable source references for the recurring judgment.

pr.description: Source PR number, or null when unknown.

findingFingerprint.description: 16-hex finding fingerprint (feedback.mjs contract). Nullable in Phase 1 (#1568 decision 2).

feedbackType.description: The feedbackType of the source entry.

rationale.description: Why this recurring judgment is a promotion candidate (auditable basis).

proposedTarget.description: Recommended promotion destination from the classification decision tree.

id.description: Optional target identifier (fixture id, skill id, rule file, etc.).

scope.description: Application scope guarding against over-broad promotion.

paths.description: Glob paths the promoted judgment should apply to. Empty until a human narrows it.

exceptions.description: Exception conditions (paths/cases) excluded from the promoted judgment.

requiresHumanApproval.description: Whether promotion into a shared asset needs human approval. Phase 1: always true.

autoActions.description: Automated actions already taken without human approval (e.g. detect-recurrence).

promotionStatus.description: Approval/lifecycle state of the candidate itself (distinct from the entry-level status). Initial: candidate.

supersedesReason.description: Reason this candidate supersedes a prior one, when applicable.

id.description: Unique identifier for the memory entry.

type.description: Type of memory (adr, review, wontfix, pattern, decision).

title.description: Optional short title describing the entry.

content.description: Full text content of the memory entry.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the entry was recorded.

updatedAt.description: Optional ISO timestamp for the latest update.

author.description: Author or agent who added the entry.

phase.description: Review phase relevant to this entry.

tags.description: Free-form tags for search and grouping.

relatedFiles.description: List of file paths related to this memory.

links.description: External links such as PRs or tickets.

confidence.description: Optional confidence score for this entry.

context.description: Optional contextual metadata (e.g., related ADR IDs, PR numbers).

supersededBy.description: ID of the entry that supersedes this one.

allOf.$comment: promotion_candidate entries carry a structured, auditable candidate under context.promotionCandidate and a required expiresAt (default 90 days, injected at build time). This conditional keeps all other entry types unchanged (#1568-A / #1621).
